source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "digital publics" OR "networked publics" OR "digital public sphere" OR "networked public sphere"
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"digital publics" OR "networked publics" OR "digital public sphere" OR "networked public sphere",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("digital public sphere" OR "digital publics" OR "networked public sphere" OR "networked publics")
